世界時鐘The World Clock

用公開數據看今天的世界，按每個來源自己的週期及時更新（每週查看）。儆醒，不懼怕。每個數字都取自來源自己的檔案（保存日期和 md5），每張卡從來源最早的一年畫起。Today's world from public data, renewed in time, by each source's own cycle (checked every week). Watching soberly, without fear. Every number is read from its source's own file (kept with its date and md5), and every card is drawn from the earliest year its source allows.

把滑鼠放在點上看名稱和最新數字，點一下到那張卡。Hover or tap a mark for its name and latest number; a click goes to its card.

每一圈分成有編號的小類（A1、A2 …，中心 0.1 …），由基本到推算；每張卡有自己的編號。Each ring is divided into numbered subcategories (A1, A2 …; the centre 0.1 …), from the basic to the derived; every card carries its own number.

2000 年以來的鐘The clocks since 2000

每個小鐘是一年（2000–2026）：同樣的四圈、同樣的位置，每個點按那一年的數字著色，用和今天同一把尺；空心圈 = 那一年沒有數字。點一下小鐘，上面的大鐘就換到那一年。Each small clock is one year (2000–2026): the same four rings and the same places, each dot coloured by that year’s figure on the same yardstick as today; a hollow ring = no figure that year. A click on a small clock turns the big clock to that year.

每一圈每年的級別Each ring, year by year: how many cards in each step

逐年的表The table by year

每一行是一張比較的卡，按編號排列；每一欄是一年。那一年有數字就畫一個點，顏色是那一年的級別（同一把尺）；沒有數字就留空。滑鼠放在點上看數字和級別，點一下那一行到它的卡。中性的卡不比較，不放在表中。One row for each compared card, in the order of their numbers; one column for each year. A dot where the card has a figure that year, in that year’s step (the same yardstick); an empty cell where it has none. Hover a dot for its number and step; a click on a row goes to its card. Neutral cards are not compared and have no row.

沒有放上的，和原因Not shown, and why

需要登入、不准轉用、或今天讀不到的來源，都不放上，在這裏寫明。A source that needs a sign-in, does not allow reuse, or could not be read today is left out and named here.
